name: sample_dataset
description: Illustrative evaluation set for a fictional company's document knowledge base. These are STRUCTURAL EXAMPLES — the document IDs below are placeholders and will only produce meaningful (non-zero) retrieval scores once documents with matching IDs and content have actually been ingested into the target tenant. Do not treat a run against this dataset as a real evaluation result unless the referenced documents genuinely exist.

cases.question: What is the company's annual revenue?

ground_truth_contexts: Year-over-year revenue growth was 18%, up from 20 crore in FY2024.
